reason: The completed MassBank feasibility audit found zero novel molecules among 491 eligible identities. No model performance was inspected. Add two directly contributed GNPS2 standard libraries without relaxing identity novelty, acquisition, minimum population or family-separation gates.

external_source.license_policy: Directly contributed GNPS reference spectra default to CC0; exclude third-party imported and propagated/MassQL/suspect libraries.
external_source.eligibility: Source-classified standard spectra; MS2, ESI evidenced in source/instrument annotation; supported adduct and matching mode; connected valid molecular structure, 150-1170 Da, precursor error <=20 ppm, at least five finite positive ordered peaks; reject explicit low-quality or inferred/synthetic acquisition annotations. Preserve raw record hash, original metadata and source URL. GNPS2 snapshot-relative record IDs are derived hashes, not claimed official accessions.

feasibility_stage: Audit every eligible source molecule against every CASMI training row using the unchanged standard/metric/exact-content exclusion policy. At least 30 novel molecules are required. Counts alone may determine feasibility; no prediction or candidate-coverage inspection.
failure_policy: Preserve the failed MassBank source and this outcome-blind addition separately. Insufficient population cannot be relabeled as external validation. No model study starts on this source unless all original independence requirements pass.
